speaker.basis: settled 2026-10-02 from fresh-translation review: Speaks as Emperor (皇帝として, 'why I am the Emperor'), defends ラース・バビロン, 'ore', Dimensional General blood + four Spheres (Taurus/Cancer/Scorpio/Sagittarius, 'their feelings live on in me'), god-killing power; story Emperor Australis; Jigoku's Gadlight Meonsam is wrong (Gadlight's Sphere is only the Sagittarius one and he is dead by then)

proposed_by_v_g059_00.basis: Speaks as Emperor (皇帝として, 'why I am the Emperor'), defends ラース・バビロン, 'ore', Dimensional General blood + four Spheres (Taurus/Cancer/Scorpio/Sagittarius, 'their feelings live on in me'), god-killing power; story Emperor Australis; Jigoku's Gadlight Meonsam is wrong (Gadlight's Sphere is only the Sagittarius one and he is dead by then)

proposed_by_v_g059_01.basis: Calls himself 次元の将であり皇帝, laments Ra's Babylon (ラース・バビロン) falling, holds four Spheres and seeks to kill a god; Jigoku said Gadlight (Geminia) but the lines are the Emperor's

proposed_by_v_g059_02.basis: Says 'I am Australis, Emperor of the New Earth Empire', awaits you in Imperial Capital Wrath Babylon, four Spheres, god-killing power, calls opponent Spiral Man / Quarreling Twins / Wounded Lion; differs from Jigoku (Gadlight Meonsam), who is addressed in 'Farewell, Gadlight Meonsam'

proposed_by_v_g059_03.basis: Spoken names include Gadlight Meonsam among other 次元将 names; the reused lines (Follow me!, Sphere answer me!) and the 次元将の闘い boast fit Gadlight; same as Jigoku

speaker.jigoku_token: ガドライト・メオンサム

59:0.en: 「I will fulfill my duty as Emperor.」

59:29.en: 「I can't forgive anyone who\nbarged into $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

59:92.en: 「I'll praise you for making me fight!」

59:168.en: 「This is the $$立ち上がる射手$$'s power!」

59:318.en: 「See $$次元将$$ and $$スフィア$$\npower fused into one...!」

59:410.en: 「I'm different from a mere\n$$スフィア・リアクター$$...!」

59:461.en: 「Show me the power that beat that one!」

59:535.en: 「Show me your power...!\nThen offer it to me!」

59:682.en: 「Spare me the empty talk!\nShow me your power!」

59:731.en: 「Cast off morality and softness!\nThat is the path to victory!」

59:784.en: 「My blood boils...!\nThe mission's weight, a strong foe!」

59:839.en: 「My honed fighting aura surrounds me!\nIt is all to defeat you!」

59:898.en: 「I've learned to master\nall four $$スフィア$$s...!」

59:1002.en: 「$$次元将$$ and four $$スフィア$$s...!\nI'll show that power!」

59:1055.en: 「Taurus, Cancer, Scorpio, Sagittarius!\nYour power, here and now!」

59:1106.en: 「The god-killing power...!\nIt is within me now!」

59:1153.en: 「I need you all\nfor even greater power...!」

59:1202.en: 「Lose to you and I'm no god-killer!」

59:1243.en: 「I go...! Alone through a war galaxy!」

59:1280.en: 「My fight lasts till the foe falls!」

59:1317.en: 「I've cut the flesh! Next, the soul!」

59:1602.en: 「One who harbors the sun...!\nI'll test that power!」

59:1651.en: 「Even with light and dark made one,\nsome things can't be overcome!」

59:1708.en: 「$$異能生存体$$...! I'll overcome your causality!」

59:1751.en: 「$$ガンダム$$!\nOnly the strong may bear that name!」

59:1802.en: 「Warrior led by civilization of fire!\nOffer up your power!」

59:1853.en: 「I'll add your name to the countless\n$$ガンダム$$s I've defeated!」

59:1922.en: 「What good is mutual understanding?!\nAnswer, $$ニュータイプ$$!」

59:1983.en: 「Admit it, $$イノベイター$$!\nBattle waits beyond dialogue too!」

59:2040.en: 「Show me the power sprouting from\nthe seed of $$シンカ$$ within you!」

59:2101.en: 「True, the Heart of Space is in you!」

59:2140.en: 「Don't think the likes of you can\nharness the beast of possibility!」

59:2261.en: 「A beast learns its rank by force...!」

59:2294.en: 「Heir to the beast's blood?\nThen show me that power!」

59:2345.en: 「$$始原の特異点$$...\nYou can't be allowed to exist!」

59:2394.en: 「$$始原の特異点$$...!\nI can't hand you over to them!」

59:2453.en: 「Sing, a song of battle!\nOffer up your life force!」

59:2502.en: 「Seen through my fighting aura,\nyou're as good as standing still...!」

59:2608.en: 「Demon God!\nKnow light can't save the universe!」

59:2657.en: 「$$ゲッター線$$ warrior,\nI won't let you go any farther...!」

59:2710.en: 「You still don't know\nwhere $$シンカ$$ is heading!」

59:2759.en: 「If you have the will to guard peace,\nthen surpass me!」

59:2914.en: 「Even your kingly power\ncan't stop my fight!」

59:2971.en: 「Demon King!\nYour desired future will never come!」

59:3020.en: 「Show me your honed combat skills!\nIf your fight has any meaning!」

59:3083.en: 「I too turn my feelings into power!」

59:3124.en: 「What is that?\nA creature even I don't know...!?」

59:3177.en: 「Rest easy, Mechanical Angel!\nI'll avenge your bitter regret!」

59:3316.en: 「If you call yourself fire,\nI'll be hellfire and smite you!」

59:3418.en: 「O battle wisdom of Earth's humanity!\nUnleash all that power!」

59:3514.en: 「Spiral Man, call the storm!\nBlast a hole in the galaxy with it!」

59:3573.en: 「Artificial god warping causality...!\nI'll destroy you here!」

59:3624.en: 「So by touching an unknown world,\nyou've gained new power!」

59:3681.en: 「A field is forming\nwith this ship at its center...!」

59:3734.en: 「So this ship is the center\nof the feelings that support you...!」

59:3787.en: 「That $$スフィア$$ will be mine too!」

59:3824.en: 「Yes! Use the $$スフィア$$ inside you!」

59:3865.en: 「If you want to beat them,\noffer me your $$スフィア$$!」

59:3918.en: 「The twelve keys, $$ソル$$'s memory...!\nI'll make it my power!」

59:3971.en: 「$$悲しみの乙女$$, grieve no more...」

59:4014.en: 「$$傷だらけの獅子$$!\nCan you endure this pain?!」

59:4065.en: 「$$揺れる天秤$$! Break, will and all!」

59:4145.en: 「To use the $$スフィア$$'s power,\nI need you!」

59:4200.en: 「Strong one! Let me show you\nsomething even you can't beat!」

59:4263.en: 「Strong one! You're about to learn\nhow vast the universe is!」

59:4386.en: 「As long as I live, my fight goes on!」

59:4464.en: 「I'll meet your attack at full power!」

59:4534.en: 「No one who comes at me escapes!」

59:4637.en: 「I bow to no foe! That's my strength!」

59:5017.en: 「A clever move. I shall commend you.」

59:5044.en: 「One with the skill and wits\nto outmaneuver even me...!」

59:5099.en: 「You will pay for this disgrace\nwith your life...!」

59:5297.en: 「Don't think petty tricks work on me.」

59:5466.en: 「If that is your all, it is pitiful.」

59:5575.en: 「You've no right to stand before me.」

59:5668.en: 「I was a fool to expect from you.」

59:5711.en: 「Why did they lose to such people...」

59:5779.en: 「What are you holding back for!?\nIs this the time? Think!」

59:5968.en: 「That $$スフィア$$ does not suit you...!」

59:6009.en: 「I cannot let one unworthy\nkeep a $$スフィア$$...!」

59:6113.en: 「All you do is howl, $$傷だらけの獅子$$?」

59:6148.en: 「Not even your will can\npierce my fighting aura, it seems!」

59:6228.en: 「Relying on $$スフィア$$s means\nyou've no right to fight me...!」

59:6363.en: 「I admit it: you're a top warrior!」

59:6406.en: 「Otherwise, those you defeated\ncould never rest in peace...!」

59:6465.en: 「Your power too shall become\na part of my fighting aura...!」

59:6514.en: 「The more I'm wounded, the stronger\nthe rebel in my heart grows...!」

59:6645.en: 「Now my taking the field has meaning!」

59:6684.en: 「A fine attack...!\nBut I too bear the name of Emperor!」

59:6737.en: 「The four $$スフィア$$s in me rejoice...!」

59:6813.en: 「At the edge of the galaxy,\nI'm grateful to have met you...!」

59:6907.en: 「Surpass me!\nIf you have the resolve for it!」

59:7001.en: 「My mission isn't over yet!\nNot while I still live!」

59:7056.en: 「This pain leads my fighting aura\nto even greater heights!」

59:7107.en: 「I'll give my all! And so will you!」

59:7183.en: 「I'm Emperor and $$次元将$$!\nDefeat is not permitted!」

59:7236.en: 「Guh! Will $$ラース・バビロン$$ fall...?!」

59:7279.en: 「That's it...!\nThis is what I came to Earth for!」

59:7365.en: 「Of us two, the winner kills a god!」

59:7402.en: 「This power...!\nIt surpasses my four $$スフィア$$s!」

59:7578.en: 「Fine! Until this fight ends,\ncall yourself Invincible!」

59:7725.en: 「Not bad...!\nI can't dismiss this child anymore!」

59:7778.en: 「Sunlight and pure feelings...!\nThey give birth to power!」

59:7829.en: 「Light and darkness, now one,\nare giving this man power!」

59:7925.en: 「Well done!\nA warrior guided by Gundam indeed!」

59:7976.en: 「It seems the Gundam of this universe\nis a cut above the rest!」

59:8039.en: 「That's it!\nUse that power to fight, $$ニュータイプ$$!」

59:8090.en: 「Admit it, $$イノベイター$$!\nYour power exists for fighting!」

59:8149.en: 「Show me the power sprouting from\nthe seed of $$シンカ$$ within you!」

59:8210.en: 「The Heart of Space gives you power!」

59:8325.en: 「Beyond beast, beyond man,\nthis one becomes god's warrior!」

59:8380.en: 「Nice, $$始原の特異点$$...!\nYou may even be a singular warrior!」

59:8451.en: 「That's it!\nKeep singing true to your life!」

59:8545.en: 「A true demon god!\nCornering even a god-killer like me!」

59:8594.en: 「This man has made $$ゲッター線$$\nhis own!」

59:8645.en: 「This man is starting infinite $$シンカ$$\nalong with $$ゲッター線$$!」

59:8757.en: 「$$メガデウス$$! Beyond the will of god,\nyou fight beside this man!」

59:8818.en: 「To corner even me,\na man worthy of the name Demon King!」

59:8879.en: 「Feelings about to overflow...!\nWhat is this man's source of power!?」

59:8987.en: 「That's it, Mechanical Angel!\nTurn your old grudge into power too!」

59:9081.en: 「Human wisdom that repelled $$バアル$$...!\nA worthy opponent indeed!」

59:9142.en: 「That's it!\nGo all-out till that power runs out!」

59:9191.en: 「Well done! You burn your own life\nto spin that drill!」

59:9250.en: 「Spiral Man! You just might\nbe able to pierce the galaxy!」

59:9315.en: 「Good! Give everything you have\nto this very moment!」

59:9372.en: 「Warrior who surpassed a soldier!\nYou've gained infinite potential!」

59:9427.en: 「Feelings gathered on this ship...!\nThey surpass even me!?」

59:9474.en: 「Your $$スフィア$$ and my $$スフィア$$\nare clashing!?」

59:9570.en: 「Even with four $$スフィア$$s,\nI can't beat this one!?」

59:9627.en: 「The 12 keys, $$ソル$$'s memory...!\nI will... not lose!」

59:9752.en: 「A will that never breaks is now\nabout to pierce my fighting aura!」

59:9858.en: 「Waiting for you to grow paid off!」

59:10055.en: 「I am $$アウストラリス$$, Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$.」

59:10196.en: 「I await you in $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

59:10382.en: 「This is the power beyond the end!!」

59:10509.en: 「$$エルーナルーナ$$, $$尸空#pilot$$, $$バルビエル$$...!」
